details.biography:
Sarah Irwin is a stunt performer and fight coordinator based in Atlanta and affiliated with SAG-AFTRA. She stands at 5'5" and is known for her expertise in gymnastics, acrobatics, wire work, boxing, high falls, and complex fight choreography.

Her impressive career spans both blockbuster films and high-profile television series. She was part of the stunt ensemble in Avengers: Endgame (2019), which earned a Screen Actors Guild Award, and later received nominations for her work on Loki: Season 1 (2022) and Guardians of the Galaxy: Vol. 3 (2023).

On-screen, Irwin often doubles for major actresses. Her credits include serving as the stunt double for Winona Ryder in Beetlejuice Beetlejuice (2024), Anya Taylor‑Joy in The Menu (2022), Sophia Di Martino in Loki, Tatiana Maslany in She‑Hulk: Attorney at Law, and numerous others such as Julianne Moore, Rose Byrne, Tilda Swinton, Anna Paquin, Rachel Taylor, Sofia Carson, and Ruby Rose.

Her filmography also encompasses performances in The Many Saints of Newark, The Woman in the Window, Like a Boss, Feel the Beat, and The Dead Don't Die. On television, she doubled across series including Blindspot, Manifest, Chicago P.D., Gotham, and The Walking Dead: World Beyond.
details.name: Sarah Irwin
